# Dependency sources

The exact unmodified Mutagen 1.48.1 source distribution is included here so recipients can obtain the GPL-covered module source beside the application source. Its archive includes upstream packaging/build files, license and tests. `python-source-index.json` records official PyPI source URLs, exact SHA-256 and sizes for all four bundled Python packages. No legacy executables are included.

The release dependency-source archive also provides the other three exact source distributions. QuickJS-NG source is directly included under `native/quickjs`. CPython/Chaquopy and AndroidX source directions are in `docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`. The app changes no upstream Mutagen source.
